name: testimonials
title: Testimonials
description: Customer quotes with named sources and roles, as cards or a single featured quote.

standards.purpose: Let real customers make the case in their own words.
useWhen: Named customers gave quotable, specific praise.
doNotUseWhen: No customer agreed to be quoted — never fabricate testimonials.

rules.check: Every quote carries a named source with a role; anonymous or invented quotes are rejected.
